tasks.analysis: Public health is a multidisciplinary field concerned with preventing disease, prolonging life, and promoting health through organized efforts and informed choices. It includes strategies such as health education, vaccination programs, and policies aimed at ensuring safe environments. Public health professionals work to identify health disparities. They also manage outbreaks of infectious diseases, promote healthy lifestyles, and contribute to improved quality of life and reduce the burden on healthcare systems worldwide. 公共卫生是一门多学科领域，旨在通过有组织的行动与科学决策预防疾病、延长寿命、提升全民健康水平。它涵盖健康教育、疫苗接种计划以及各类保障安全环境的公共政策。公共卫生从业者致力于发现不同群体间的健康差异，管控传染病疫情，倡导健康生活方式，从而提升整体生活质量，减轻全球医疗体系的负担。
